description: This file is an assembly source implementing standard string and memory functions for PowerPC architecture, such as strcpy, strncpy, strcat, strchr, strcmp, strncmp, strlen, memset, memmove, memcpy, memchr, memcmp, and cache flushing routines.

methods.name: strcpy
methods.description: Copies a null-terminated string from source to destination.

methods.name: strncpy
methods.description: Copies a specified number of characters from source to destination.

methods.name: strcat
methods.description: Concatenates a source string to the end of a destination string.

methods.name: strchr
methods.description: Finds the first occurrence of a character in a string.

methods.name: strncmp
methods.description: Compares a specified number of characters of two strings.

methods.name: strlen
methods.description: Calculates the length of a string.

methods.name: memset
methods.description: Fills a block of memory with a specific byte value.

methods.name: memmove
methods.description: Copies memory areas, handling overlapping regions correctly.

methods.name: memcpy
methods.description: Copies a block of memory from source to destination.

methods.name: memchr
methods.description: Searches for a byte in a block of memory.

methods.name: flush_cache
methods.description: Flushes and invalidates the CPU cache for a specified memory range.
